items.title: Rahm reigns again after Niemann wins LIV Golf New York
items.description: Jon Rahm clinched the LIV Golf season points title for a third straight year despite finishing tied for 41st at LIV Golf New York, where Joaquin Niemann claimed a three-shot victory for his ninth win in the last three years.

items.title: African quartet secure Women's World Cup places
items.description: Algeria, Morocco, Cameroon and Malawi all qualify for the 2027 Women's World Cup in Brazil by reaching the semi-finals of the Women's Africa Cup of Nations.

items.title: Messi misses Miami defeat after death of father

items.title: McInnes left frustrated amid Rangers' poor start to season
items.description: Derek McInnes is still seeking a win after three games as Rangers managers and feels hard done by following a 2-1 home defeat by Hibernian and injury to big-money striker Youssef Chermiti.
